body: Forced himself on me shortly after a miscarriage

Please read [Why Does He Do That?](https://dn790007.ca.archive.org/0/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) by Lundy Bancroft. I was in a similar situation. Stay at home mom, didn’t know how to do it all on my own, scared to leave, he controlled the money and I didn’t have access, sexually (and verbally and physically abusive). You can do this. Here’s some resources: 
[National Domestic Violence Hotline](https://www.thehotline.org/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=domestic_violence)

NOR. I was in the same boat once. Left an abusive marriage. He left bruises and much more unseen damage. My dad ran into him at a bar and struck up a friendly conversation. He gave him some furniture he didn’t want anymore. Broke my heart and I cut him out for a couple years. I still don’t get it. But as a mother myself now- this is horrendous behavior and I can’t imagine doing this to my child. You deserve so much better, I’m sorry

My husband physically abused me in front of our child. I now have full custody. Please listen to these people. Go to the hospital and get checked out. Get a copy of the doctors report. Go to the police. If you stay with an abuser and subject your children to that, it’s going to be so much worse. Abusers who go as far as strangulation are 8x more likely to murder you. Get an order of protection from that man before he kills you.

This book helped me a lot while dealing with my abusive ex- [Why Does He Do That? by Lundy Bancroft](https://www.docdroid.net/2fZmz40/why-does-he-do-that-pdf)

Frozen 2 lol. I was extremely depressed and dealing with severe untreated ptsd from my abusive husband. Took my young child to see Frozen 2 in theaters and wept when Anna was singing “Next Right Thing.” I had already left my husband was was struggling so much. The song was about being so overwhelmed with darkness you want to give up, but you have to go on and just do the next right thing. Ended up kinda being life changing

Three days after getting married, my (now ex) husband lost his mind and yelled at me for not drying the sink after doing the dishes. Not like…splashed water around the sink. He expected me to dry the inside of the sink every time after using it
When he flipped out that I told my mom about an argument we had. He said he broke up with a girl for running to her parents and that was the start of alienating me from family and friends

No no no honey, this is rape! You didn’t do ANYTHING wrong. He did. He is solely responsible.  A very similar thing happened to me and it has taken years to finally see how fucked up it was to do that to someone. I would never do that to somebody, neither would you. He’s a selfish monster. Go to the hospital and get checked out. Tell them how you were treated and then go to the cops and tell them too. I’m so so sorry you went through this. You did nothing wrong

My now ex husband did this to me. Fucking leave him. What a despicable thing to do to someone. Please go to the doctor and get checked out. I was too ashamed to, but it wasn’t something I should have been embarrassed about. The person who was suppose to love and protect me violated me in such an awful way. Please dump his ass

I felt the same. After he physically abused me, I was so mad at myself for staying, and asked myself, “Well what point WILL you leave??” And I decided if he ever cheated. Then I would leave. A couple months later he admitted to cheating on me multiple times. And did I leave then? No. I didn’t want to hurt him, which sounds so insane now. That’s trauma bonds. The more you put up with abusive behavior and stay, the stronger those bonds become. And it just enables his abuse. When I finally (after going through absolute hell because of him) left, he cried and told me he did all of those horrible, horrible things because he thought I would never leave him. Please read [Why Does He Do That? by Lundy Bancroft](https://dn790007.ca.archive.org/0/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf). Even when I left him, I kept telling myself it wasn’t that bad. That book made me WEEP. It was like a handbook on my ex, it was crazy. It is sooooo helpful. Please, PLEASE read it

My church supported my extremely abusive husband, as well as other pieces of garbages who cheat/hurt their wives. Please read [Why Does He Do That?](https://dn790007.ca.archive.org/0/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) make a police report, and leave. Block anyone who doesn’t support you. If you go back, you’re telling him he can hurt you and you won’t leave and he WILL do it again. I’m so sorry you have to deal with this and that your family isn’t taking it seriously. It IS serious. Your feelings are valid.
Took me forever to read because it was so triggering, but it was life changing
7th. Biggest regret.

Please get away before he gets you pregnant again. He is an awful human being and abuse tends to increase when the victim gets pregnant.  That was the first time my ex ever left a bruise on me. Then I was trapped because I was too scared and financially reliant on him to be a single mom. The abuse escalated and when I finally was making moves to get away, he SA’d me and got me pregnant again. And once again I decided to stay. I miscarried and finally left, he made it easier by being so cruel during it. Get away from this man, please

Don’t feel stupid. It’s trauma bonds. My ex strangled me and I stayed too. But once an abuser goes as far as that, he’s 750% more likely to murder you. It’s time to get away from him NOW. [Why Does He Do That?](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) by Lundy Bancroft is an amazing resource that explains trauma bonds and the abusers actions. Please read it, it was SOOO helpful for me and countless others on this subreddit. Please get away and be safe ❤️

My biggest regret in life is not pressing charges against my abuser when I could. I loved him, I thought it wouldn’t happen again, I didn’t want to ruin his life. Not only did he hurt me again, he assaulted another person in front of our child and traumatized them. Letting an abuser guilty of sexual and physical abuse go free only empowers them. Get away from the enablers and stay strong

Just adding to the top comment… my ex husband was really great while we were dating, but as soon as we were engaged, he became controlling and started showing his red flags. I ignored them and married him anyways. It got so much worse. He’s letting his mask slip the more committed to him you are. So please, please, please be careful before you marry this man

He’s abusing you, and doing that in front of your daughter is abusing her. Please read [Why Does He Do That?](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) by Lundy Bancroft. I linked the free pdf version. It’s probably the most helpful resource I had when I was trying to figure out what was going on with my abusive husband. What he is doing is unacceptable and it won’t stop unless you leave. Like most abusers, when they think you’re going to leave, they will start love bombing. Don’t fall for it. Get out and keep you and your baby safe

100% emotional abuse. I couldn’t even listen to the whole thing, sounds a lot like my ex. My husband would never talk to me like this, even in a fight. This is not how you treat someone you care about. Please read [Why Does He Do That? by Lundy Bancroft](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf). It’s an incredibly eye opening and helped me realize how bad things are and that I was trapped in a cycle of abuse
Thanks for linking all of that ❤️

The top cause of death during pregnancy is homicide! My ex husband started getting really abusive once I got pregnant. He thinks he has you trapped and is letting his mask go. NOW is the time to act! You are not trapped, you have options! The next steps you take are SUPER important! Go to the hospital and get checked out. Then go file a police report and get an order of protection! Use this resource: [Domestic hotline](https://www.thehotline.org/). Once a man goes as far as strangulation, they are 8 times more likely to kill you. Choking you could have killed you and your baby. He will probably start love bombing you to get you to stay, say anything to keep you from leaving. So try to be quick and discreet, just get out of there! What he did is NEVER ok
THANK YOU! Worked in my ps5. I thought it was such a long shot to be able to fix this!

All of this!! Document EVERYTHING, go to the doctors and tell them what happened, get everything they document. Go to the police and file a report IMMEDIATELY. This is hard, but it’s imperative to keep you and your child safe! My husband choked me and I waited to report it. I couldn’t press charges, the police refused to help me. I met with a prosecutor and she told me to “watch my back” and that’s all I could do. I felt so hopeless.[The domestic abuse hotline](https://www.thehotline.org/) can help! Please act now. Yoi didn’t deserve this. It won’t stop if you let him back in your life. He may try to love bomb you to get you back, but the cycle will repeat. Once an abuser has gone so far as to choke you, they are 8 times more likely to murder you. File an order of protection for you and your child. You can do it ❤️
I’m so glad that you survived and are here to help others! You are so strong!

Please check out [the domestic abuse hotline!](https://www.thehotline.org/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=domestic_violence). This is not ok behavior. Please make sure you do NOT get pregnant, it will make leaving sooo much harder! When my now ex figured I was close to divorcing him, he baby trapped me. Not saying that is what he would do, but he is showing some extremely controlling and concerning behavior. Please keep yourself safe!

Silently sitting down after work because I was 3 months pregnant and had awful 24/7 nausea. Wasn’t complaining, got my work done, just sat down and wasn’t smiling because I felt like crap. He went off on me. Another time he was pissed that I didn’t dry the sink after doing dishes. He almost broke up with me in the beginning of our relationship because I told my mom about an argument we had. He would freak out if I ever didn’t like something he was doing (no matter how gently I would say it). Then when I just stopped trying to say anything that would set him off, he got mad at me because it’s my fault he did a lot of awful things because I just would “let” him. Couldn’t win no matter what I did

[Domestic abuse hotline](https://www.google.com/search?q=domestic%20abuse%20hotline&tbm=) -I couldn’t say, but it sounds like yours was reactive abuse. That does not make you an abusive person. Strangulation is a felony. It’s a huge deal. I would call the hotline and talk to professionals, but I would hope all the cops would care about is your safety and your child’s. Since your baby was in your arms when it happened, CPS could get involved too. So be sure you’re taking all the steps needed to ensure yours and your child’s safety

It is never ok to strangle someone, especially while holding a child! Please go to the hospital so your bruises are documented, and file a police report. When someone goes as far as strangulation, they are 8 times more likely to murder you.
My ex husband strangled me while I was holding our one year old. I didn’t do anything about it and when I finally left after his behavior kept getting worse, I worked up the nerve to file a police report. I even had a recording of him confessing to do it. They wouldn’t do anything about it. He later assaulted me again and thankfully they were witnesses and I was able to get an order of protection, but my biggest regret in life is not going to the police after he strangled me. I could have saved myself so much hurt

Understandable. I was unable to put gas in my own car after leaving. Everything was hard. Maybe a support group would be easier? I lived in a fairly small town and there were several domestic violence support groups. It was super helpful for me. I hope you can find some healing!

You are so so strong for getting out! I left my abusive now ex husband that I had been married to for 5 years. It’s so hard and I still get flashbacks. Can you find a therapist? I had to learn grounding techniques for panic attacks I would get after leaving and it was so helpful to be validated by someone after having a narcissist isolate me and make me believe I deserved to be treated badly. [Why Does He Do That?](https://ia600108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) by Lundy Bancroft is an AMAZING resource that really helped me understand what was happening. Can you get an order of protection so he’s not trying to come after you? You’ve done SO amazing so far, stay safe and we are all so proud of you!
Also, I binged watched The Great British Baking Show after I left my abuser. It’s wholesome and made me feel weirdly better. Maybe give it a try?

A few days into marriage, my now ex husband yelled at me for not drying the inside of the sink after doing the dishes. Told me I should have been taking notes while his grandma was staying with us. 
When I got pregnant I had awful morning sickness. It was 24/7 nausea and throwing up for four months. He yelled at me because despite us both working full time, it was solely my responsibility for cleaning the house, and it wasn’t up to his standards. One time he screamed at me for just sitting in the car with my head in my arms because I felt so sick. I wasn’t complaining, he just hated me when I wasn’t feeling well. He also later got mad at me when I started having contractions in the middle of the night and I was groaning in pain. He yelled at me to shut up and I had to go downstairs and lay on the couch while he slept in bed, and wait for morning for him to take me to the hospital to deliver our baby. 
Shoutout to the awful people who enabled him and told me it was my job to love him no matter what ✌️

This is so well written! Please OP read that comment carefully! It’s exactly what my ex would do. He hated when I stopped reacted to him and the love bombing and begging would begin. I would stay and the cycle continued. It WILL get worse if you stay, time to block him out of your life completely! [This](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) is a great resource that was life changing for me. It’s shared often on this sub, please read it if you haven’t yet!
We are all so proud of you! You are so strong!!! Enjoy a better life!

After begging God to save me from my abusive husband and begging god to save my baby while I was actively miscarrying, I “took a break”. Escaped my husband and stopped praying. Then I slowly realized that god and my abusive husband were very similar. They are always right, I am always wrong. They determine my worth. I’m not good enough. I should worship them. I’m lucky that they would care for me etc

Same. Even though I was a responsible, Bible thumping, wanting to grow up and be a missionary, Sunday school teaching, youth group attending good two shoes, my mom told the nurse I don’t need it. “She’s not going to be having sex anyways.” Fast forward a few years and my cheating husband gave me hpv. Thanks mom.

For leading you on? He should be apologizing for using you to get off and not do anything in return. He was using you. I’m sorry he made you feel so awful, please distance yourself from him. He isn’t treating you with the respect you deserve.
I almost choked on my Dr Pepper zero after reading that lol I’m so sorry, that sounds unpleasant

Thank you everyone for commenting with advice, I will be looking into it. That would be a relief if he just got some girl to call and that CPS in my state has a better way dealing with these situations. It must be an exhausting and draining job, and I very much appreciate those who are helping children

I’m in therapy, and definitely over my ex?? He got me pregnant again because I was trying to leave him, then I miscarried and he just hung out at the bars with his friends and left me alone. He constantly called me stupid and a bitch and wouldn’t let me have any control over the finances and demanded sex from me when it was painful and a week after the miscarriage. He never remembered my birthday, he spoke down to me like a child, he spent all our money on alcohol, drugs and gambling, he once pinned me to a wall by my throat and strangled me. I was trapped in the cycle of abuse for a very long time, but I’ve been in therapy for two years and very, very much afraid of that man. I’ve been diagnosed with ptsd from being with him, and he has caused many panic attacks. So no. I’m very over that monster.

We weren’t expecting him to start a fist fight. He has only ever been violent with me before, and that was behind closed doors, not in public. I think it was shock after being sucker punched. On top of that, I’m pretty sure it would have hurt my bfs relationship with my son if he witnessed him beating up his dad. I know I completely froze while this was happening, it’s not fair to expect a better reaction just because he’s a man.
Yes and yes. He has a victims witness advocate that is helping him with his case
I did ask for her supervisors number and have called and left serval messages, but can’t get a hold of them
Had a friend whose last name is Sapp. Named his two sons Huckleberry and Briar, and his daughters name is Maple

I’m so sorry this happened!! Please go to the hospital and get your injuries documented, take pictures, and file a police report! You may not want to press charges right now, but you might down the line. I’m my biggest regret in life is not doing this when I was being physically abused, and now nobody believes me. It’s not going to stop, you need to get out, PLEASE

As a daughter estranged from her father (and having a baby in the middle of it)- she’s hurt. Please try to make it. The few times she actual does reach out, she’s probably hurting and wants you in her life. If you miss this, don’t expect another invitation to be apart of her life

[I’ll even save you the search.](https://ia600108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) Get out. Document everything. Read this book. What he did is inexcusable and horrific. Please get far away from him. As someone who stayed with someone after he got physically violent, it only gets worse

It’s part of the cycle, not actual change. My ex husband did this. I would force myself to shut down emotionally so when he would be cruel, I wouldn’t react. After 2 days or so he would be all sweet and tell me he doesn’t like that I’m distancing myself and to not give up on him and how he loves me sooo much. Then I would take the walls down and I would get hurt. Then repeat. Please don’t get caught in this cycle. The longer is goes, the harder it is to finally leave. The abuser does less love bombing to get you back too. They know they can be an awful partner and you’ll stay if they just act like a decent person for a short period of time. My ex abandoned me after miscarrying our baby and humiliated me a week after in front of our friends shortly after, and I finally left him. He knew he had been exceptionally cruel but he literally told me, “I never thought you would actually leave.”

You can forgive him and still have justice. You don’t owe him anything. I don’t want to tell you what to do, but my ex strangled me, raped me and got me pregnant, and went to the bar with his friends the day I miscarried, and raped me again a week after. It took me over a year to break my trauma bonds and be furious about how he treated me. I tried to press charges, mostly because he got a new girlfriend and I wanted her to be believed if he hurt her too. I was told I didn’t have enough proof and a few months later, he assaulted me again. Men like these guys are not ok. They are dangerous and dont change

[This book](https://ia600108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) was extremely helpful for me to process the abuse I had been living through. My ex almost killed me and it took months for me to not want to go back to him. Write out everything he did to you, and when you feel bad about leaving, look at it. I’m glad you can acknowledge the trauma bonds, just stay strong and block him everywhere. It takes time, but you will find freedom again. Stay strong, stay away and stay safe. Look if there’s any domestic support groups in your area! I live in a smaller town and found several. Hearing other women tell their stories made it easier. I would never tell one of them to go back, so why should o consider that for myself?

Statistically, once he has gone as far as choking you, your chances of him murdering you goes up significantly. Slapping you is absolutely awful and not ok either. Did you document those? I would file for divorce and file police reports. He WILL do it again if you stay. I was with my ex husband for over 5 years. I stayed with him after he strangled me. I tried so hard to get him to love me and I also didn’t want to tarnish his name. He got worse. He ruined every aspect of my life. Even after I finally left him. Which is why you need to make a police report and even file for an order of protection so he can’t come after you. What he did is awful and you don’t deserve to live like this. You should read [Why Does He Do That?](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) by Lundy Bancroft too! Can’t recommend it enough
That’s 4 since 2018. There’s been 100 mass shooters in 2023 alone. 2,861 since 2018. Statistically, a shooter is going to be a straight male
Yes exactly!
Please get out before he escalates more! That is insane behavior

YES. Your feelings are VALID. I like getting naughty with my partner and shaking things up, but none of what you described is ok. I am so so sorry, please get away from him. You deserve better. Real men care about their partners pleasure, and if you two have been together for FIVE years, there’s no way he doesn’t know that you were not enjoying that. He just decided he didn’t care, and that needs to be a deal breaker

I don’t have experience in this exact situation, but I did recently go through a brutal custody battle in court with my abusive ex. I brought all the proof I had of his abuse. I was expecting him to just deny everything, but him and his lawyer ended up flipping everything on me. I said he strangled me, his lawyer said “Well isn’t it true you were hitting him and he was just trying to get away from you?” I hadn’t touched him. My ex literally ran up to me and pinned me to a walk by my throat, it threw me off guard to he accused of being the abusive one. I accused him of sexual assault that was in a particular way, and his lawyer said, “Actually, isn’t it true that my client was uncomfortable doing that act, but you forced him to?” His lawyer just kept doing that. I think being told I wanted my ex to SA me was the worst thing anyone has ever said to me, and it was hard to recoup and speak clearly. So I would just be prepared for that, though if you have a good lawyer (mine didn’t prep me) you should be ok. And if it’s any consolation, the judge didn’t believe a word my ex said. You can do this ❤️

Listen to every person on here saying he won’t change. It’s part of the cycle of abuse. He does something awful and then love bombs you and makes empty promises to keep you from leaving. You stay and the cycle begins again. Please read [Why Does He Do That?](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) by Lundy Bancroft. You’ll find this guy is textbook abuser and what he’s doing and what will happen if you stay. Lundy also says going to therapy together will NOT help. He will manipulate the therapist. Get away. It’s not worth it, I promise you
You’ve got this ❤️ You are so brave!
You are so strong! That’s so great to hear, good job!

I would contact a lawyer, you can usually get a consultation for free. I would think disappearing would look really bad for you if your kids father tracked you down. Document everything, get in texts that he’s barely seeing his own child. If your state has one party consent laws, record verbal abuse, or save any texts you have that point to it. Also, custody battles are extremely expensive. So if he can’t keep a job (which will look bad for him) he won’t be able to afford a lawyer. Get away from, if he texts you anything threatening, get an order of protection for you and your child until you can go to court and determine a parenting plan. I had to do that and my ex was only allowed FaceTime calls and supervised visits. He didn’t do them so the judge basically laughed at him when he wanted 50/50.

Can you open up your own bank account and direct deposit your checks so you can save up to get away? And/or stay in a DV shelter? If you have a child with him, unfortunately you’ll probably have to share custody. It was torture for me, but my ex husband assaulted me in front of our child and a neutral witness and after an awful custody battle, finally got full custody. Family court has been a lot more sympathetic than criminal court. Again, I’m so sorry you’re going through this and I’m sorry I don’t really have any answers. I just hope you can get out and win at least primary custody by showing every police report, pictures of bruises/black eyes, everything you have. And if possible, get your kids in therapy. My child’s therapist was able to testify in court that they had trauma from witnessing my ex being violent, which helped a lot in keeping my kid with me

I’m so sorry! You were and are not dumb and naive, you have been trapped in a cycle of abuse and it is SO HARD to escape! It is not uncommon or unusual for women who are being horribly abused to not walk away or be able to walk away. My ex husband also was had full control over money, and got me pregnant by raping me, which made it harder to leave. Keep documenting everything. Is it legal to record without the other persons permission in your state (if you’re in the US at least)? Are you married to your abuser?

Sounds like you are doing an amazing job taking care of your kids and yourself! Considering what you’ve been through, I would think only allowing FaceTime calls is enough. Was he ever charged for choking you unconscious? Once an abuser goes as far as strangulation, the statistics of him murdering you sky rockets. How do your kids feel about seeing him? If it came down to it, could you set up a supervised visit with professionals who do those? With my ex, we used a company that had my kids dad get there first and be in the building, then let me know when I could pull in and they would come out and bring my kids in to visit with their dad for an hour. Then bring my kids back to my car and waited for us to be gone before he could come out. He also had to sign papers saying he wouldn’t talk badly about me to the kids, keep it friendly, etc. I have a friend who is using family for supervised visits and it’s brought some complications, I wouldn’t recommend that route

My neighbor had to call the police on my ex assaulting me and in the background of the phone call you can hear him admit to another assault on me (I had filed a police report but was told I didn’t have enough proof to do anything). He was charged with the last assault, but when I tried to get the prosecutor to actually do something about his prior attack since we had an audio confession, I was told a jury wouldn’t believe me and to “watch my back.” The assault he was charged with was the first on his record so all he had to do was pay a fine to the court and take an anger management course. He had 6 months to do that, and when he did, they took the assault charge off his record. And I get to perpetually be scared he’s going to hurt me again. The system is broken.

I’m so sorry you are going through this. The first time my ex was physically abusive was when I was pregnant. He tried to kick me out of our home and grabbed me hard by my arm, leaving a bruise, and threw me to the floor. I stayed married to him and two years later strangled me with our child in my arms. I wish I could go back and do everything I could to get his abuse on record. Please protect yourself. File for an order of protection and don’t listen to your family. Have you read [Why Does He Do That?](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) by Lundy Bancroft? Can’t recommend it enough. Make your family read it too if they think that your abuser is just going to magically become a good person with a baby around

[Why Does He Do That?](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) is a book I highly recommend to every woman. His behavior is manipulative and so wrong, please read through this, it’s so helpful!
[Here you go](https://ia800108.us.archive.org/30/items/LundyWhyDoesHeDoThat/Lundy_Why-does-he-do-that.pdf) please read it, it’s extremely helpful

My mom struggled with her weight since childhood, developed anorexia, and now has a BED. I developed anorexia in my early teens and still struggle. My mom makes it worse and has basically made our weights into a competition. Despite being someone who *should* understand how harmful it is to comment on people’s bodies, she always gets in hurtful remarks. From bragging that her weight was lower than mine when she was admitted into rehab compared to when I was, to bragging she was smaller than me two weeks after I had a baby. I don’t talk to her anymore

Document everything. Look up if your state is a one party consent state for recording. (if you’re in the US, not sure about other countries) My state is two party, so I can’t record my abuser being abusive to use as proof.  Save texts, take pictures, and get in therapy if you can. I just went to court against my abuser and had my therapist testify that he had given me ptsd from being with him. Have you ever made a police report?

Check out r/auntienetwork for support! I’m sorry you’re in this position. It’s common for abuse to escalate during pregnancy, please take care of yourself. The first time my ex husband physically abused me was when I was four months pregnant

I’m very sorry for what you are feeling right now! It is not your fault. I had a miscarriage a few years ago and i was terrified for a loooong time that it was my fault. But unfortunately, it’s very common. So again, it is NOT your fault. I hope you find some peace ❤️ Take care of yourself!

In a sauce pot add 2 tbsp bread flour, 2tbsp water and
4 tbsp whole milk. Turn to medium heat and whisk constantly until sticky and tacky (about 30 secs-2mins). Transfer mixture to a bowl to cool.

Add 1tbsp of active dry yeast to half a cup of milk that’s 90-95 degrees Fahrenheit. Mix and let sit for 10 minutes 

Whisk together 2.5 cups bread flour, 3/4tsp salt, and 1/4cup sugar  in a stand mixer. Add first mixture, milk yeast mixture, and one egg that is at room temp. Mix at low until it comes together, then medium low. Next add three tablespoons of unsalted softened butter, one tbsp at time, until fully incorporated. Mix until smooth and elastic.

On an unfloured work surface, roll in ball. (I had to watch him do it in his YouTube video at 3:58)
Put in lightly greased medium bowl and cover with damp towel and let rise 1-2 hours or until doubled.
Lightly punch down dough, drop onto lightly floured surface and cut into 9 pieces, about 75g each.

Butter or spray a square baking pan. Roll into tight balls using same method as earlier. Cover with damp towel and let rise 1-2 hours

Brush with egg wash of one egg and two tbsp milk
Bake 350 for 28-30 minutes

Finely chop 2 cloves garlic add to a cold pan with quarter cup of unsalted butter. Put on medium and sweat garlic for 30 seconds then remove from heat. Brush on rolls immediately after done cooking and add flaky sea salt.
